articles.title_en: Russian drones strike Kyiv, damaging 24-story apartment building and injuring five
articles.lead_en: A Russian drone struck a 24-story residential building in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi District overnight on September 9, hitting the structure at the level of the 11th and 12th floors, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. The strike sparked a fire on the 12th floor and tore through interior walls, according to Klitschko.
